english_draft: This document is a historical reconstruction. It uses only information published before July 23, 2026. It was not written before the Q3 earnings date. Intel reported Q2 2026 revenue of $16.1 billion, up 25% year over year. GAAP EPS was $(2.16). Non-GAAP EPS was $0.42. Non-GAAP gross margin was 41.8%. Data Center and AI revenue was $6.3 billion, up 59%. Intel Foundry revenue was $5.8 billion with an operating loss of $2.1 billion. Intel guided Q3 2026 revenue to $15.8-16.8 billion. GAAP EPS is expected to be $0.31. Non-GAAP EPS is expected to be $0.38. GAAP gross margin is expected to be 41.0%. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be 42.0%. Three core questions arise. First, can DCAI growth continue after 59% growth in Q2? Second, can non-GAAP gross margin reach 42% as Intel increases equipment and substrate investment? Third, can Intel Foundry narrow its operating loss? No consensus forecast is available in the source. The earnings verification points are revenue position within guidance, non-GAAP EPS, gross margin, segment revenue, foundry operating loss, and operating cash flow.
reader_questions: Q3 收入指引中值 16.3B 与 Q2 实际 16.1B 几乎持平，而 DCAI 同比 +59% 是 Q2 主要增长引擎，这是否意味着指引隐含 DCAI 环比明显放缓？
Q2 GAAP 净利润受 'Escrowed Shares' 按市值计价损失等非现金项目影响，Q3 GAAP EPS 指引 0.31 是否仍包含类似项目？
Intel Foundry 收入含内部交易，其 2.1B 经营亏损中有多少来自产能爬坡和折旧？Q3 毛利率指引 42% 是否隐含 Foundry 亏损扩大？
